Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "接收者同时须有与所述目的相关的知情需要，并受保密义务约束。", "name": "need_to_know_and_confidentiality_bound"}, {"meaning": "本单元对该规则没有附加的知情需要或保密约束条件。", "name": "no_additional_condition"}, {"meaning": "存在其他条件、条件仅部分匹配，或当前窗口不足以准确表达。", "name": "other_or_unresolved_condition"}], "examples": [{"choice": "need_to_know_and_confidentiality_bound", "quote": "(c) to restrict access to Confidential Information to those of its officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement; and", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "no_additional_condition", "quote": "(a) not to, directly or indirectly, in any way, disclose, make accessible, reveal, report, publish, disseminate or transfer any Confidential Information to any third party;", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}], "name": "disclosure_conditions", "question": "判断最后一个单元对该接收者类别施加的适用条件。条件必须来自本单元的实际文字，不得因通常合同惯例而补入。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_conditions|unit|29", "operation": "disclosure_conditions", "unit_ids": [29], "current_units": [{"id": 29, "text": "2.5 The Recipient shall not be precluded from disclosing the Confidential Information that is (i) obtained by the Recipient without restriction from a third party who is not in breach of any obligation as to confidentiality to the owner of such Confidential Information or any other person, or (ii) disclosed by the Discloser to a third party without any obligation of confidentiality, or (iii) previously known by the Recipient, or (iv) at any time is developed by the Recipient completely independently of any disclosures hereunder."}], "focus_unit_id": 29}]}
